name: ferry-sdk-monorepo
description: Typed SDK, CLI and MCP server for the FerryVN ferry-ticket platform API

scripts.generate: npm run openapi:filter && npm run generate -w @ferryvn/sdk
scripts.generate:check: npm run generate && git diff --exit-code -- openapi/sdk.json packages/sdk/src/generated
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ferryvn/sdk && npm run build -w @ferryvn/cli && npm run build -w @ferryvn/mcp
scripts.smoke:mcp: node scripts/smoke-mcp.mjs && node scripts/smoke-mcp.mjs --writes && node scripts/smoke-mcp.mjs --http
scripts.verify: npm run version:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run build && npm run smoke:cli && npm run smoke:mcp && npm run smoke:sdk && npm run pack:check
